source_read: PMC HTML, PMC13623016 (author manuscript NIHMS2209286; Inj Prev, published before final editing 13 Aug 2026; title confirmed in own tab): all sections, Tables 1 and 2 (as text), Key Messages box, funding, conflicts, ethics, disclaimer, data statement, reference list. Figures 1 (flowchart by manner, system and state) and 2 (map): screenshot of own tab blank, figure image not viewable; no values taken from them. Blind notes written before the card was opened. Paragraph counts are running-text paragraphs only (Background 5, Methods 6, Results 7, Discussion 12); the Key Messages box, captions and table notes are not counted.

key_findings.note: Methods 1st-3rd paragraphs give the sources, states, years and any age; no ICD-10 codes or case definition anywhere; coroners/medical examiners as the classifiers is stated in Background 2nd paragraph as well as the 4th.
Recomputed 3.06% vs 8.95% (8.9%); crude OR 0.321 (Woolf 0.29-0.35) equals model 1; Maryland attribution in Results 4th paragraph.
Table 2 models 2-5 and n=55,423 as printed.

Model 5 values are in Table 2 and Discussion 5th paragraph; Results 6th paragraph gives the model 4 values (autopsy 1.29, narrative 0.52, note 0.46), so cite it for model 4 only. Tests 'largely insignificant' is Discussion 6th paragraph.
Values are Table 2 model 5; Results 5th paragraph prints the model 3 values (0.93, 0.96, 0.62), Results 7th paragraph age and the 23% figure.

reporting_issues.note: SD recomputed: 46.82 for 37,436 vs 46.88 for 37,346; printed 46.8.
Also rurality model 5 0.96* (0.93-1.00) cannot be p<0.001.
Same paragraph also turns the lowest point estimate into a floor ('at least 52%'); lowest lower CI limit is 1.20. The card records this under interpretation_gap; it could stand as a reporting issue.
Sums recomputed (55,758; 37,537; 18,221). The 11 is a net figure: at least 11 coroner-county deaths lack a category, more if categories also overlap there.
No year fixed effects in Methods; only state indicators (Methods 6th paragraph).

risk_of_bias.note: ROBINS-E some concerns overall. Five domains at some concerns sits near ROBINS-E's multiple-domain route to high; I keep some concerns because the adjusted estimate is stable (1.52-1.61) and the exposure error probably biases toward the null. It would move to high if the NVDRS/SUDORS coverage were found to differ by county type.

interpretation_gap.note: Minor. The most consequential element is the abstract giving 1.79 as if unadjusted and omitting the reversed pooled OR 0.32 (3.1% vs 8.9% crude).

missed: Causal verbs for associations: Results 5th paragraph (unemployment 'reduced the odds'), Results 6th paragraph (autopsy 'raised the odds'), Discussion 5th paragraph (suicide note 'reduced the odds ... by 54%'). Cross-sectional associations; the card notes only the autopsy reading.
